title: Entrance Antiphon - 23rd Sunday OT
author: Sirach 36:18
snippet: Give peace, O Lord, to those who wait for you, that your prophets be found true. Hear the prayers of your servant, and of your people Israel

title: Responsorial Psalm 24th Sunday A
author: (Psalm 103: 1-2, 3-4, 9-10, 11-12)
snippet: The Lord is kind and merciful, slow to anger, and rich in compassion.

title: Gospel Acclamation
author: John 13:34
snippet: I give you a new commandment, says the Lord; love one another as I have loved you.

title: Loving and Forgiving
author: Scott Soper
snippet: Loving and forgiving are you, O Lord; slow to anger, rich in kindness, loving and forgiving are you.

title: Communion Antiphon - 23rd Sunday OT
author: Corinthians 10:16
snippet: The chalice of blessing that we bless is a communion in the Blood of Christ; and the bread that we break is a sharing in the Body of the Lord

title: Open My Eyes/Abre Mis Ojos
author: Jesse Manibusan
snippet: Open my eyes, Lord. Help me to see your face. Open my eyes, Lord. Help me to see.

title: Beautiful Is Your Love
author: Josh Blakesley/Sarah Hart/Marc Byrd
snippet: Oh how beautiful is your love for me. Oh what joy is mine in this mystery. I will not fear the dark, here in the presence of your heart. Oh how beautiful is your love.

title: Psalm_103
author: Jim Ngo xSuno
snippet: The Lord is kind and merciful O Bless the Lord, O Bless the Lord! The Lord is kind and merciful O Bless the Lord, O Bless the Lord!

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
